description:
This is a request for information (RFI). This RFI is issued for market research purposes only. It does not constitute a commitment by the Government, nor is it a solicitation or request for quotes or offers. Responses to the RFI are not offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. Responses are voluntary and non-binding. The Government will not pay for any costs incurred in response to this RFI. All costs associated with responding to this RFI will be solely the responding party’s expense.

See attached document for additional information as well QR code and link to provide response to RFI.
